scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "dotnet watch run --non-interactive --project apps/api/api.csproj" "bun run --cwd apps/web dev"
scripts.build: dotnet build apps/api/api.csproj && bun run --cwd apps/web build
scripts.db:ef:add: dotnet ef migrations add --project apps/api/api.csproj --output-dir migrations
scripts.db:ef:sql: dotnet ef migrations script --idempotent --project apps/api/api.csproj --output apps/api/migrations/migrate.sql
